summary.en: Five years ago, in the middle of a huge campus belonging to a college, a beautiful but despaired young woman climbs to a tower. After taking a good look at her surroundings, she sadly closes her eyes and throws herself off. The perspective switches to students who witness the girl's suicide, then to a flock of doves that fly away. A woman named Sakurako Suzuka committed suicide by jumping from a high roof, in the middle of her college's main campus.
